datacenter.description: For ensuring that datacenter is correctly formatted into array

hibernateEnabled.description: Indicates that the declared state of the Cassandra Cloud Service is stopped.

storageClassName.description: Type of pvc used. Leave it empty, and it will pick up the default storage class from cloud provider

accessModes.description: Desired access modes for the volume

backupEnabled.description: Automatic backup for this cassandra ring

backupMaxAgeDays.description: Number of days after which the backups will be purged from the Cloud bucket

cleanupStorageOnTerminate.description:
Controls whether storage resources (such as PVCs) should be cleaned up when the cassandra service is terminated.
This flag is propagated to the cassandra CRD which is used by the k8ssandra operator to decide
if storage resources need to be cleaned or not.

title:
This type is used to transform an instance of CassandraDB_Config to a K8sC3Cassandra V2 operator K8s custom resource.
The K8s custom resource officially bears the API version "ops.c3.ai/v2" and Kind "C3Cassandra".
name: CassandraDB_Config.K8sC3CassandraV2Transform
